run_vrhand_simulation: run the pybullet simulation that loads a virtual hand and Jenga blocks for VR glove control
convertSensor_normalize: use convertSensor to normalize a raw VR glove sensor reading to a 0-1 float value
getSerialOrNone_connect: use getSerialOrNone to attempt opening a serial port and return None on failure
createConstraint_hand: use createConstraint to attach the simulated hand to a fixed joint in the pybullet world
setJointMotorControl2_fingers: use setJointMotorControl2 to set position control targets for individual hand finger joints
